adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members` the diff introduces unvalidated pagination params for all groups: `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i`, then uses them directly in `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)`. There is no cap on `limit` and no guard against negative values, so a client can request an excessively large limit (potential DoS via large query/serialization) or negative limit/offset (can raise/produce invalid SQL depending on adapter), leading to 500s. This is directly evidenced by the added code.
